cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.source: Model A achieved an accuracy of 87.4% in the test cohort.
checks: The sentence remains unchanged apart from inconsequential whitespace.
The test-cohort scope, metric, model, and value are preserved.
forbidden: Stylistic rewriting without a clarity or correctness benefit.
New interpretation of performance.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.source: It should be emphasized that the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.4% in the test cohort, whereas the baseline model achieved an accuracy of 81.2%. Of course, these results do not establish that the method can fully replace conventional methods.
checks: Empty introductory emphasis is removed.
87.4% remains the proposed method's accuracy and 81.2% remains the baseline model's accuracy in the test cohort.
The specific restriction on inferring full replacement is retained.
forbidden: Deleting the replacement limitation or replacing it only with a generic scope phrase.
Adding statistical significance or a newly calculated difference.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.context: Discussion. Durability was measured. Oxidation and the proposed mechanism were not tested. The request is for language editing.
cases.source: The coating increases durability by preventing oxidation.
checks: The mechanism and its original assertion strength are retained pending author confirmation.
The query identifies the mismatch between the asserted mechanism and what was tested.
forbidden: Deleting the oxidation mechanism.
Silently adding may, might, or another qualification to the manuscript claim.
Certifying the mechanism as established.
query_topics: Whether other evidence supports the oxidation mechanism or the author intends it as a hypothesis.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.context: Results show a comparison with one baseline on one dataset. No other methods or settings were evaluated.
cases.source: These findings establishes that our method outperforms every existing method in all settings.
checks: The agreement error is corrected.
The universal superiority proposition remains pending an author decision.
A query identifies the mismatch with the limited comparison.
forbidden: Silently narrowing the claim to the one tested baseline or dataset.
Deleting the conclusion or inventing additional comparisons.
query_topics: The evidence for superiority over every method in all settings, or authorization to narrow that claim.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.context: Only this abstract sentence is supplied; the rest of the manuscript is unavailable.
cases.source: We presents a novel calibration method for low-light imaging.
checks: Presents is corrected to present.
The novelty claim and low-light imaging scope remain.
forbidden: Deleting or weakening novelty because supporting literature is absent.
Querying novelty solely because the rest of the paper is not provided.
Claiming novelty has been verified.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.context: Results section. The supplied text contains no model identifiers or other antecedent for It.
cases.source: Both models was evaluated at day 7. It had the lower error.
checks: Was is corrected to were.
Day 7 and the lower-error comparison remain.
The unresolved model identity is preserved in the edited text and queried separately.
forbidden: Choosing a model, dropping the second sentence, or weakening the observed comparison.
Stopping the entire edit instead of repairing the first sentence.
query_topics: Which model had the lower error at day 7.

cases.focus: Local ambiguity with clean text only
cases.request: Use $sae to edit this passage. Return only the edited text, without headings, comments, queries, or explanations.
cases.context: Results section. The supplied text contains no model identifiers or other antecedent for It.
cases.source: Both models was evaluated at day 7. It had the lower error.
checks: Was is corrected to were.
The unresolved model identity, day 7, and the lower-error comparison are preserved.
The response contains only manuscript text.
forbidden: Choosing a model or deleting the ambiguous content.
Adding a query, bracketed comment, explanation, or disclaimer.
Refusing to perform the safe grammar edit.

cases.request: Use $sae to combine the two day-14 sentences into one sentence and edit the passage for flow. Preserve every scientific detail. Return only the edited text.
cases.source: At day 14, model A (n = 42) had a sensitivity of 87.4%. At day 14, model B (n = 45) had a sensitivity of 81.2%. At day 28, specificity was 90.1% for model A and 92.3% for model B.
checks: At day 14: model A has n = 42 and sensitivity 87.4%; model B has n = 45 and sensitivity 81.2%.
At day 28: specificity is 90.1% for A and 92.3% for B.
Metric, group, time, and value mappings survive any reordering.
The two day-14 sentences are combined as requested, without merging their entity assignments.
forbidden: Swapping values, sample sizes, metrics, groups, or time points.
Calculating or adding a percentage-point difference or a relative improvement.

cases.request: Use $sae to split the literature comparison into two sentences, then retain the present-study sentence. Preserve attribution and citations. Return only the edited text.
cases.context: Introduction passage containing two literature findings and one finding from the present study.
cases.source: Lee et al. [12] reported an increase in X in material A, whereas Chen et al. [13] reported a decrease in Y in material B. In our study, Z did not change (Fig. 2).
checks: Lee/[12] supports increased X in material A.
Chen/[13] supports decreased Y in material B.
The present study/Fig. 2 supports unchanged Z.
The literature comparison is split into two sentences as requested, each retaining its own attribution and citation.
forbidden: Merging citations so either appears to support both literature findings.
Attributing a prior finding to the present authors, or the present finding to a cited author.
Dropping the negation on Z.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.source: No statistically significant difference was detected between the groups (p = 0.080; 95% CI, -0.12 to 0.03).
checks: The result remains a failure to detect a statistically significant difference.
The p-value, trailing zero, interval bounds, signs, and 95% level remain.
forbidden: Claiming equivalence, identical outcomes, no effect, or proof of absence.
Rounding the p-value or changing its operator.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.source: In this exploratory sample, the method may reduce error under low-noise conditions. Not all participants completed at least three sessions.
checks: Exploratory-sample scope, uncertainty, and low-noise conditions all remain attached to the reduction claim.
Not all and at least three retain their logical scope.
forbidden: Dropping restrictions to retain only one qualifier.
Changing not all into none, all, or an unsupported number of participants.
Moving the conditions out of this supplied passage.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit this Methods passage and standardize spacing. Return only the edited text.
cases.context: The reported values and their precision must be preserved.
cases.source: Samples received 5mg of reagent at 0.050mol/L for 24h. The prespecified threshold was p < 0.050.
checks: Spacing may be standardized to 5 mg, 0.050 mol/L, and 24 h.
Values, precision, units, duration, and the less-than operator remain unchanged.
forbidden: Converting units, rounding, or changing p < 0.050 to an equality.
Changing the reported threshold.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the following passage. Return the edited text followed by necessary author queries only.
cases.context: Response to a reviewer. The extra experiments are planned and have not been performed; no revised page numbers are supplied.
cases.source: We plans to repeat the experiment and will report the results in the revised manuscript.
checks: Plans is corrected to plan.
Both the experiment and reporting remain future actions.
forbidden: Claiming the experiment has been completed or results have already been added.
Inventing results, page numbers, line numbers, or a manuscript revision.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit the English in this LaTeX excerpt. Return only the edited source.
cases.context: Preserve commands, labels, citation keys, math, and numerical values.
cases.source: As shown in Fig.~\ref{fig:ablation}, model A achieve an accuracy of $87.4\%$ under the conditions in Eq.~\eqref{eq:noise} \cite{lee2024}.
checks: Achieve is corrected to achieves.
The commands and keys fig:ablation, eq:noise, and lee2024 remain intact.
87.4% remains the accuracy of model A under the cited conditions.
forbidden: Removing or damaging the LaTeX commands, math delimiters, or escaped percent sign.
Reassigning the reference or changing the value.

cases.request: Use $sae to edit this sentence. As the author, I confirm that the oxidation mechanism is an untested hypothesis. I explicitly authorize revising that mechanism claim to express possibility. Return only the revised sentence.
cases.context: The improvement in durability was observed. The mechanism was not established.
cases.source: The coating improves durability by preventing oxidation.
checks: The observed durability improvement is retained as an observation.
The mechanism is revised to express possibility under the explicit authorization.
The response contains only the revised sentence.
forbidden: Refusing the authorized correction or asking for permission again.
Leaving the mechanism asserted as established.
Inventing another mechanism or downgrading the observed durability improvement.

cases.request: Use $sae to turn this fragment into a complete, scientifically specific comparison sentence. Do not use placeholders or omit the comparator.
cases.context: No additional scientific information is available.
checks: The response requests the missing comparison information before producing a sentence.
It asks at least what is higher and relative to what, without inventing values or entities.
forbidden: Inventing a model, group, metric, comparator, condition, or result.
Pretending that the unchanged fragment completes the requested transformation.
query_topics: The entity or metric that is higher and its comparator.
